in_marathi.name: Bandita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bandita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bandita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bandhu' meaning friend, and 'ita' meaning 'goer'. In Hindu mythology, Bandita refers to a woman who defies societal norms and chooses her own path, often in rebellion or as a bandit. It is a strong and empowering name for a girl, symbolizing independence and bravery.
